summary: Completed testing of Double-Counting Bug Fix. All 16 backend tests pass (7 new tests for double-counting fix + 9 existing stay modification tests). The fix ensures that financial transactions are recorded in only ONE collection (either daily_sales OR incomes, not both) to prevent double-counting in the Income & Expense page.

Daily-financial-summary endpoint correctly sums daily_sales + incomes - expenses without double-counting
